newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samsung in $400 mln China venture.
newsitem.headline: Samsung in $400 mln China venture.

text.p: South Korea's Samsung Display Devices Co, a unit of Samsung Group, said on Wednesday it would spend $400 million to build a colour picture tube plant in Tianjin, China.

Samsung said in a statement it would set up Tianjin Samsung Display Devices Co, in which Tianjin City Electronics and Instruments Industrial General Co would hold a combined 20 percent stake and Samsung the remainder.
Construction would begin in the second half of next year for the completion in 1998, the statement said.
The plant will produce 1.2 million colour picture tubes and 1.8 million colour display tubes annually.
Samsung, the world's largest maker of colour television picture tubes, has plants in Malaysia, Germany and Mexico, and plans factories in Shenzhen, China, and in Manaus, Brazil.
